caption: The Gran Turismo DD Pro box has a 5 Nm base, the GT rim, a table clamp and two CSL Pedals with no load cell. Our Rosso GT swaps those pedals for CSL Pedals with the Load Cell Kit, about $220, because GT7 is all about braking. Before a screen it comes to $1,748. Prices are our estimates. We earn from qualifying purchases. #granturismo7 #ps5
title: Fanatec GT DD Pro: is the brake in the box good enough for GT7?
